The sheer number of species has led to the recognition of subgenera and groups, some of which may be promoted to genus level. Tmolus echion | Tmolus echion, the red-spotted hairstreak or larger lantana butterfly, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family.  It is found from Brazil, north to Sinaloa and Tamaulipas in Mexico.  Rare strays can be found in southern Texas.  It was introduced to Hawaii in 1902 to control lantana.
Lantana montevidensis | Lantana montevidensis is a species of lantana known by many common names, such as: trailing lantana, weeping lantana, creeping lantana, small lantana, purple lantana or trailing shrubverbena.
